the UK male and female age-standardised incidence rates increased for prostate cancer and breast cancer and decreased for lung and colorectal cancer.
The UK incidence rate increased for the four most common cancer types in males, and decreased for the three most frequent cancers in females.

the male incidence rate increased in the UK and the constituent countries for prostate cancer, but decreased for lung cancer and in Scotland for colorectal cancer; the UK female incidence rate for breast cancer increased and in Wales decreased for colorectal; and UK mortality rates fell in males and in females for breast cancer and colorectal.
